name: Custom Webhosting Panel
author: ArixByte
description: A custom Pterodactyl egg for webhosting panel deployments. Includes startup variables for custom webroot, PHP version, and panel services.

STARTUP_COMMAND.description: Custom startup command for the webhosting panel.

WEBROOT.description: The document root for your hosted website.

PHP_VERSION.description: PHP version for the hosted website environment.

HTTP_PORT.description: Port used by the internal HTTP server.

PANEL_HOST.description: Panel domain or hostname used by the webhosting panel.
